summary:
This is a draft for counsel's review, computed from the record with machine-checked lines (investigator lines matched by key words in code; the suspect's lines labeled by a model and checked by code). Borderline suspect-side calls need review.

Across 24 key details Brendan Dassey stated or agreed to, investigators introduced 8 first, 4 were already public, 1 may trace to an earlier unrecorded statement, and 11 came from him first in the record. In the three recorded sessions, investigators spoke 68–88% of the words and used repeated fact-carrying questions (366 in S2, 291 in S3) alongside tactics such as "we already know" assertions (36 in S2), minimization (16 in S2), and demands for truth (43 in S2). One detail (tattoo on stomach) was raised by investigators but never adopted.
key_points: Origin breakdown: 8 details interrogator-first, 11 suspect-first in the record, 4 public before the interviews, 1 possibly from an unrecorded prior contact (headline; counts).

Vehicle in garage: Investigators asked "Who's car was in the garage?" and stated "Her jeep was in the ga-garage wasn't it?" (p. 548); he agreed (p. 548). Earlier he mentioned "car...the...jeep" (p. 458), "seen her jeep down at Steven's house" (p. 469), "We got five in the garage" (p. 529).

Knife: Investigators asked "Where's the knife that he used to stab her?" and "Where did he say he hid the knife in the car?" (p. 460–461); he agreed (p. 463). No earlier suspect statements in the transcripts.
Shot in head: Investigators asked "Who shot her in the head?" (p. 587); he agreed (p. 587).

Shot inside garage: Investigators asked "Take her outside of the garage and shoot her?" (p. 591) and "where, in the garage" (p. 596); he said "In the garage" (p. 596) and adopted the detail after (p. 597).

Tires and branches on fire: Investigators said "you see the branches, the tires, the garbage, it's all on the fire already?" (p. 454); he agreed (p. 454). Earlier he said "bottom of tires" (p. 452), "branches" (p. 453), "Branches, tires, tires, like a garbage bag" (p. 454).

Blood on garage floor: Investigators stated "We know the fire was going... Where else in the garage?" (p. 547, 551); he adopted at p. 608. Earlier he mentioned blood on shirt (p. 475) and "On the floor" (p. 551).

Phone, camera, purse in burn barrel: Investigators asked "At what point did you put her cell phone and camera and purse and stuff in the burn barrel?" (p. 817) and asserted "the truth is you put her purse and her cell phone and her camera in the burn barrel" (p. 819); he adopted at p. 835. Earlier he said "He burnt 'em" (p. 620) and described purse contents (p. 621–622).
Tattoo on stomach: Investigators raised it (p. 662); he never stated or agreed to it.
limits: The audit traces only where details appear in the available transcripts; it cannot assess the truthfulness or reliability of any statement.
The unrecorded evening session with Fassbender (Feb 27, 2006) has no public transcript; any fact-feeding there is not captured.
The analysis does not evaluate voluntariness, coercion, or the legal admissibility of the statements.
Machine labeling of suspect lines may miss or misattribute borderline utterances; those calls need human review.
